WITH filtered_item AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
),
filtered_date AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM filtered_date dd
        WHERE dd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    )
),
sales_agg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT fd.d_year, fi.i_brand_id AS brand_id, fi.i_brand AS brand,
           SUM(fs.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
    FROM filtered_sales fs
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT dd.d_year
        FROM filtered_date dd
        WHERE dd.d_date_sk = fs.ss_sold_date_sk
    ) fd ON TRUE
    JOIN filtered_item fi ON fi.i_item_sk = fs.ss_item_sk
    GROUP BY fd.d_year, fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_brand
    ORDER BY fd.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
    LIMIT 100
)
SELECT d_year, brand_id, brand, sum_agg
FROM sales_agg
ORDER BY d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
